title: The Crash Loop
story: The billing service restarts every few seconds. Customers cannot pay. The log hints at a configuration problem.
goal: Fix /etc/billing/config.yaml so the service reads port: 8080.

files./var/log/billing.log:
ERROR config: unknown key 'prot' in /etc/billing/config.yaml (line 3)
ERROR service exited with code 2
files./etc/billing/config.yaml:
name: billing
workers: 4
prot: 8080
log_level: info

hints: Read the log. It names a file, a line and a key. What does the file say on that line?
The key is misspelled. sed can fix text in a file: sed -i 's/old/new/' file
socratic: Which file does the log point to?
Which line looks wrong when you read it?
Which command edits text inside a file without opening an editor?
explain: In one sentence: how did the log tell you what was wrong?
